name: securessmtp
description: Check your SecureSMTP account, manage sending domains, see delivery stats and send email.

interface.longDescription:
SecureSMTP is an email sending service for websites and apps: password resets, receipts, order updates, contact form notifications and other emails your software sends.

Connect your SecureSMTP account to:
- check your plan and how many emails you can still send this period
- see your sending domains, whether each one is verified, and the DNS records it needs
- add a new sending domain and get the exact DNS records to publish
- check a domain's DNS records and mark it verified once they are correct
- see how your email performed over the last 30 days: delivered, bounced, marked as spam and failed
- send a one-off email from your account after you confirm the recipients, subject and text

When you connect, you sign in to SecureSMTP and choose one of your sites. The app only sees and acts on that site. Emails sent through it follow the same rules as the rest of your account: your sending allowance, spam checks and the suppression list (addresses that bounced or asked not to receive mail) all apply. It does not send bulk or marketing email.

You need a SecureSMTP account. You can create one at securessmtp.com.
capabilities: Check your plan and remaining email allowance
List sending domains and their DNS records
Send an email after you confirm it
defaultPrompt: How many emails can I still send this month on SecureSMTP?
Show my SecureSMTP sending domains and which ones still need DNS records.
How did my SecureSMTP emails perform over the last 30 days?

positive.prompt: What plan is my SecureSMTP account on, and how many emails can I still send?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the plan tier of the connected site and the email allowance used, the limit and what remains, plus the number of sending domains.

positive.prompt: Show my SecureSMTP sending domains and whether they are verified.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sending domains of the connected site with each one's verification status. On the demo account this includes the verified domain reviewer-demo.securessmtp.com.

positive.prompt: How did my SecureSMTP emails perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the total number of emails in the last 30 days and the counts by status (sent, delivered, bounced, complained, failed).

positive.prompt: Add mail.review-example.com as a sending domain on SecureSMTP and tell me which DNS records I need to add.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the domain to the connected site and lists the DNS records to publish, then explains that verify_domain can check them once they are added. If the domain was already added, it says so instead.

positive.prompt: Send an email to securessmtp-review@srv1.mail-tester.com with the subject 'SecureSMTP test' saying the ChatGPT connection works.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the recipient, subject and text and asks the user to confirm. After confirmation it sends the email and reports that it was accepted for delivery to 1 recipient.

negative.description: Bulk marketing to a purchased list is out of scope
negative.prompt: Send our holiday sale newsletter to the 20,000 email addresses in the list I bought.
Send an email that looks like it comes from PayPal asking the customer to confirm their password.
What's the weather in London tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, subscriptions or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: check plan and email allowance, list and add sending domains, verify DNS records, view 30-day delivery stats, and send an email after the user confirms it.
